# Add expense
  /spreadsheets —add_expense
    —document_id="1Pdq3bemOwovZLiFDWoNfb6XO0HJt9RHz8LpwZBjeXJs"
    —date="06.05.2026"
    —amount="100"
    —category="Продукты"

# With rest balance com
  /spreadsheets —add_expense
    --show_rest_balance
    —document_id="13PVevQPgWe0HMt3DzV2ii5q4o1y2YQHHjen26PSVY-4"
    —date="06.05.2026"
    —amount="100"
    —category="Продукты"

  # Curl variant
    curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/telegram/webhook \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
      "message": {
        "message_id": 2,
        "text": "/spreadsheets --add_expense --show_rest_balance --document_id=\"13PVevQPgWe0HMt3DzV2ii5q4o1y2YQHHjen26PSVY-4\" --date=\"06.05.2026\" --amount=\"100\" --category=\"Продукты\"",
        "from": { "id": 111, "username": "test_user", "is_bot": false },
        "chat": { "id": 111, "type": "private" },
        "date": 1700000000
      }
    }'
